dialog.permissionMissing: Preparing a sample needs the {{permission}} permission, which your role does not hold.

assignmentRule: Sample Assignment Rule: This sample is currently assigned to {{names}}. Only an assigned analyst may prepare this sample, unless reassigned by an authorized Section Head.

confirm.loadLotsError: Could not load the available lots.
confirm.pendingApprovalInfo: This item's preparation configuration is still awaiting Section Head approval. It is in effect and can be confirmed now - approval is a separate review and does not hold up testing.
confirm.needsMaterialMapping: This item's diluent/neutralizer is not linked to master data, so no lot can be recorded for this sample. A Section Head can link them under Laboratory Configuration → Items.
confirm.auditNote: Confirming records these exact values against this sample. Later changes to the item's configuration will not alter this record.
confirm.signatureMeaning: I confirm the preparation steps shown above are the steps performed for this sample.

manual.loadLotsError: Could not load the lots for this selection.
manual.noConfigInfo: {{itemName}} has no preparation configuration yet. What you enter here becomes its standing configuration for future samples, and is sent to the Section Head for approval - testing is not held up waiting for it.
manual.signatureMeaning: I confirm the preparation steps entered above are the steps performed for this sample, and are correct for this item.

lotPicker.noneUsable: No usable {{role}} lot of {{name}} is available.

whereUsed.loadError: Could not load where this lot was used.
whereUsed.empty: Not used in any test preparation yet.

grouped.needsMaterialMapping: This item's diluent/neutralizer is not linked to master data, so no lot can be recorded. A Section Head can link them under Laboratory Configuration → Items.
grouped.auditNote: Confirming records these exact values against every sample listed above, each with its own signature. Later changes to the item's configuration will not alter those records.
grouped.signatureMeaning_one: I confirm the preparation steps shown above are the steps performed for {{count}} sample of {{itemName}} listed in this group ({{references}}). The diluent and neutralizer lots selected apply to every sample in the group.
grouped.signatureMeaning_other: I confirm the preparation steps shown above are the steps performed for all {{count}} samples of {{itemName}} listed in this group ({{references}}). The diluent and neutralizer lots selected apply to every sample in the group.
